children.text: Overview:
Description
Loss of airspeed, altimeter, VSI on PFD. Affects gear warning, TAD, transponder Mode C. Use BFI.
Loss of audio or ICS in one or both cockpits. Can affect UHF/VHF communications.
ADS-B signal not received or transmitting erroneous data. ATC may advise. May require disabling transponder.
Loss of squawk or mode C/S/ADS-B. Affects ATC visibility and TCAS.
Theory of Operations:
It uses electrical buses (fused circuit hubs) to isolate and organize electrical loads.
A bus tie system connects the forward and aft cockpit buses for redundancy and efficiency.
Circuit protection is provided by circuit breakers in both cockpits.
Monitoring and fault protection include voltage sensors and annunciator lights.
The system enables dual-cockpit control and automatically prioritizes power to essential components in the event of failures.
Power Sources:
Starter/Generator
Bus
Key Components
Provides continuous power to critical systems even when the BAT switch is OFF.
(N) If an EDM A INOP or EDM B INOP advisory remains, suspect a data bus malfunction. Prior to flight, maintenance action is required.
ADC circuit breaker (right front console) - Check, reset if open

(N) If the ADC FAIL warning remains displayed, the air data computer has failed. Primary airspeed, altimeter, and VSI will be inoperative. Reference backup flight instrument and AOA as necessary. TAD, aural gear warning, and transponder mode C will also be inoperative. Expect PMU STATUS caution to illuminate after landing.
Switch COMM lead to auxiliary cord (affected cockpit) - Initiate as required
AUDIO circuit breaker (right front/rear and left front/rear console) - Check, reset if open
